Implemented the CLI in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js) with its bundled validation table in [output/rules.json](/workspace/output/rules.json).

It supports ISO 2709 and MARCXML inspection, ISO 2709 and MARCXML rendering, UTF-8 field payloads, normalized leader templates, and structured errors. I verified an ISO 2709 round trip containing Unicode text and a MARCXML render/inspect round trip. The entry point passes `node --check`.
